details.soft_blurry_image: Image lacks sharpness and crisp detail. Facial features appear soft and out of focus. Overall image is мыльно (soapy/blurry).
details.eye_artifacts: Eyes show signs of generative artifacts. Pupils and irises lack clean definition. Eye shape appears distorted.
details.eyelash_artifacts: Eyelashes are clumped, missing, or artifacted. Natural eyelash structure not preserved.
details.mouth_teeth_artifacts: Mouth area shows distortion. Teeth are poorly formed or missing. Mouth shape appears artificial.
details.over_smoothed_skin: Skin is excessively smoothed with loss of natural micro-detail. Pores and skin texture absent.
details.wax_plastic_face: Facial skin has waxy, plastic-like appearance characteristic of over-smoothed generative output. Lacks natural skin reflectance.
details.hair_detail_soft: Hair is rendered as soft blobs rather than individual strands. Hair detail is not sharp or readable.
details.quality_transfer_failed: Quality reference (V6 elderly portrait / бабка) did not successfully transfer its sharpness, skin detail, and natural appearance to the V7 output.
